LiHua has expressed a positive attitude towards the soreness in their arm muscles, as indicated by the conversations between JenniferMoore and LiHua. Initially, when Jennifer inquires about the soreness after a bench press session, LiHua responds with enthusiasm about the good feeling of soreness, referring to it as "love the burn." This suggests that LiHua not only accepts the soreness as a natural part of their workout but also finds satisfaction in experiencing it, implying a belief in its role as a sign of progress and a beneficial part of their fitness journey.

Moreover, during a discussion about adjusting training intensity for recovery, LiHua supports the idea of easing up and focusing on recovery, reinforcing a responsible and mindful approach to fitness. In response to Jennifer's proposal for low-impact workouts and stretching sessions, LiHua agrees and looks forward to the modified plan, which shows an open-mindedness towards alternative methods that aid in recovery and maintain progress.

In summary, LiHua seems to consider the soreness as a manageable and even welcome aspect of their training regimen, reinforcing the idea that they are committed to improvement while also valuing rest and recovery.
